s0001.literal: Emperor Chengzong Qinming Guangxiao, taboo name Temür, was a grandson of Shizu and the third son of Yuzong Zhenjin.
s0001.idiomatic: Emperor Chengzong Qinming Guangxiao, taboo name Temür, was a grandson of Shizu and the third son of Yuzong Zhenjin.

s0002.literal: His mother was Empress Huiren Yusheng of the Onggirat clan.
s0002.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Huiren Yusheng of the Onggirat clan.

s0003.literal: He was born on gengzi day of the ninth month in the second year of Zhiyuan.
s0003.idiomatic: He was born on gengzi day of the ninth month in the second year of Zhiyuan.

s0004.literal: In the twenty-fourth year Prince Nayan rebelled; Shizu personally led troops to suppress and pacify him.
s0004.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year Prince Nayan rebelled; Shizu personally led troops to suppress and pacify him.

s0005.literal: Afterwards Hedan rebelled again; the Emperor ordered Temür to campaign against him, and Hedan was defeated and destroyed.
s0005.idiomatic: Afterwards Hedan rebelled again; the Emperor ordered Temür to campaign against him, and Hedan was defeated and destroyed.

s0006.literal: On yisi day of the sixth month of the thirtieth year he received the heir apparent's seal and commanded armies on the northern frontier.
s0006.idiomatic: On yisi day of the sixth month of the thirtieth year he received the heir apparent's seal and commanded armies on the northern frontier.

s0007.literal: In the thirty-first year, first month of spring, Shizu died; princes of the imperial clan and major ministers dispatched envoys to announce mourning to the army.
s0007.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year, in the first month of spring, Shizu died; princes of the imperial clan and major ministers dispatched envoys to announce mourning to the army.

s0008.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on renwu day, the Emperor arrived at Shangdu; all princes of the left and right wings assembled.
s0008.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on renwu day, the Emperor arrived at Shangdu; all princes of the left and right wings assembled.

s0009.literal: Earlier, Surveillance Commissioner Cui Yu had obtained a jade seal in the house of a former official; its inscription read "Received mandate from Heaven; long life and eternal prosperity"; he presented it to Empress Huiren Yusheng.
s0009.idiomatic: Earlier, surveillance commissioner Cui Yu had obtained a jade seal in the house of a former official; its inscription read "Received mandate from Heaven; long life and eternal prosperity"; he presented it to Empress Huiren Yusheng.

s0010.literal: At this time she personally transferred it to the Emperor.
s0010.idiomatic: At this time she personally transferred it to the Emperor.

s0011.literal: On jiawu day he ascended the imperial throne, received the court audience of princes, imperial clan members, and civil and military officials at the Great Peace Pavilion, and issued an edict saying:
s0011.idiomatic: On jiawu day the Emperor ascended the throne, received the court audience of princes, imperial clan members, and civil and military officials at the Great Peace Pavilion, and issued an edict saying,

s0012.literal: "We consider that Taizu the Sacredly Martial Emperor received Heaven's bright mandate, first established the realm of China, sage succeeding sage, illuminating the former line.
s0012.idiomatic: "We consider that Taizu the Sacredly Martial Emperor received Heaven's bright mandate, first established the realm of China, sage succeeding sage, illuminating the former line.

s0013.literal: Down to our late emperor, who embodied the fundamental and held to the center, only then were institutions and culture fully complete.
s0013.idiomatic: Down to our late emperor, who embodied the fundamental and held to the center, only then were institutions and culture fully complete.

s0014.literal: Ruling for thirty-five years, within the four seas and beyond, none failed to submit; his grand design and far-reaching plans, his deep kindness and profound benevolence, were sufficient to extend the Yuan's myriad-age boundless fortune.
s0014.idiomatic: Ruling for 35 years, within the four seas and beyond, none failed to submit; his grand design and far-reaching plans, his deep kindness and profound benevolence, were sufficient to extend the Yuan's myriad-age boundless fortune.

s0015.literal: Our honored father early established his heir's position; his virtue was great and his achievements lofty, but Heaven granted him no long years, and the four seas lacked what they hoped for.
s0015.idiomatic: Our honored father early established his heir's position; his virtue was great and his achievements lofty, but Heaven granted him no long years, and the four seas lacked what they hoped for.

s0016.literal: Looking upon our slight person, we have received our late emperor's exceptional favor; in the summer of last year he personally bestowed the heir apparent's seal and entrusted us with command of the armies.
s0016.idiomatic: Looking upon our slight person, we have received our late emperor's exceptional favor; in the summer of last year he personally bestowed the heir apparent's seal and entrusted us with command of the armies.

s0017.literal: Now in spring the imperial carriage has gone afar and suddenly abandoned the people; then worthy princes of the imperial domain and imperial brothers, old kin and officials, declared ancestral teaching could not be violated nor the imperial regalia left vacant; embodying our late emperor's long-entrusted intent, they jointly and repeatedly urged us to ascend, their sincerity earnest and their resolve firm.
s0017.idiomatic: Now in spring the imperial carriage has gone afar and suddenly abandoned the people; then worthy princes of the imperial domain and imperial brothers, old kin and officials, declared ancestral teaching could not be violated nor the imperial regalia left vacant; embodying our late emperor's long-entrusted intent, they jointly and repeatedly urged us to ascend, their sincerity earnest and their resolve firm.

s0018.literal: We reluctantly yielded to their request; on the fourteenth day of the fourth month we ascended the imperial throne; a great amnesty throughout the realm is granted.
s0018.idiomatic: We reluctantly yielded to their request; on the fourteenth day of the fourth month we ascended the imperial throne; a great amnesty throughout the realm is granted.

s0019.literal: We still bear in mind the various policies of the former court, all having established rules; we shall only carefully uphold them and dare not neglect or lose them.
s0019.idiomatic: We still bear in mind the various policies of the former court, all having established rules; we shall only carefully uphold them and dare not neglect or lose them.

s0020.literal: We further rely on imperial-clan kin and meritorious relatives, the loyal and good at our sides, each to exhaust their sincerity in assisting our imperial virtue.
s0020.idiomatic: We further rely on imperial-clan kin and meritorious relatives, the loyal and good at our sides, each to exhaust their sincerity in assisting our imperial virtue.

s0021.literal: Let this be proclaimed near and far, that all may hear and know.
s0021.idiomatic: Let this be proclaimed near and far, that all may hear and know.

s0022.literal: The edict remitted corvée tax in Dadu and Shangdu routes for one year, and elsewhere reduced adult land tax and grain by three-tenths.
s0022.idiomatic: The edict remitted corvée tax in Dadu and Shangdu routes for one year, and elsewhere reduced adult land tax and grain by three-tenths.

s0023.literal: All arrears owed to government offices were entirely remitted.
s0023.idiomatic: All arrears owed to government offices were entirely remitted.

s0024.literal: For civilian households that had fled, all corvée taxes were remitted.
s0024.idiomatic: For civilian households that had fled, all corvée taxes were remitted.

s0025.literal: Our late father was posthumously honored as emperor; the grand empress dowager, former consort, was honored as empress dowager.
s0025.idiomatic: Our late father was posthumously honored as emperor; the grand empress dowager, former consort, was honored as empress dowager.

s0026.literal: On gengzi day Acting Grand Preceptor Udutai and others were dispatched to request a posthumous title at the Southern Suburb.
s0026.idiomatic: On gengzi day Acting Grand Preceptor Udutai and others were dispatched to request a posthumous title at the Southern Suburb.

s0027.literal: Vice Minister of Rites Li Kan and Bureau Director of the Ministry of War Xiao Taideng were dispatched bearing an edict as envoys to Annam.
s0027.idiomatic: Vice minister of rites Li Kan and bureau director of the ministry of war Xiao Taideng were dispatched bearing an edict as envoys to Annam.

s0028.literal: Central Secretariat officials said: "Your Majesty has newly ascended the great throne; gifts to princes and imperial sons-in-law should follow the precedent of the annual great assembly: where one ingot of gold was granted, add four to make five; where one ingot of silver was granted, add two to make three.
s0028.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "Your Majesty has newly ascended the great throne; gifts to princes and imperial sons-in-law should follow the precedent of the annual great assembly: where one ingot of gold was granted, add four to make five; where one ingot of silver was granted, add two to make three.

s0029.literal: Also the land tax allotment in Jiangnan was at first verified only by household registers, with each household paying five hundred cash in notes; this too should now be increased, yet it is not fitting to increase levies on the people; we request that the five hundred cash be raised to two ingots, supplied by the government from this year forward.
s0029.idiomatic: Also the land tax allotment in Jiangnan was at first verified only by household registers, with each household paying 500 cash in notes; this too should now be increased, yet it is not fitting to increase levies on the people; we request that the 500 cash be raised to two ingots, supplied by the government from this year forward.

s0031.literal: On yisi day imperial son-in-law Mangzi was granted seventy-six thousand five hundred taels of silver with tally, Kuolejisi fourteen thousand four hundred fifty taels, and King Wang Ju of Koryo thirty thousand taels.
s0031.idiomatic: On yisi day imperial son-in-law Mangzi was granted 76,500 taels of silver with tally, Kuolejisi 14,450 taels, and King Wang Ju of Koryo 30,000 taels.

s0032.literal: On dingwei day bandits and robbers broke out in the jurisdictions of the Huguang branch secretariat; Liu Guojie was again ordered to suppress them.
s0032.idiomatic: On dingwei day bandits and robbers broke out in the jurisdictions of the Huguang branch secretariat; Liu Guojie was again ordered to suppress them.

s0033.literal: On wushen day Venus appeared in daylight and also transgressed Ghost.
s0033.idiomatic: On wushen day Venus appeared in daylight and also transgressed Ghost.

s0034.literal: An edict ordered relief for the armies campaigning against the Li Miao and Java.
s0034.idiomatic: An edict ordered relief for the armies campaigning against the Li Miao and Java.

s0035.literal: On jiyou day the Yunnan branch secretariat submitted its established routes, prefectures, and counties: two upper routes, eleven lower routes, forty-nine lower prefectures, one middle county, and fifty lower counties.
s0035.idiomatic: On jiyou day the Yunnan branch secretariat submitted its established routes, prefectures, and counties: two upper routes, 11 lower routes, 49 lower prefectures, one middle county, and 50 lower counties.

s0036.literal: Aru, a submitted official of Jinchi, was made superintendent of Mengding Route and granted a tiger tally.
s0036.idiomatic: Aru, a submitted official of Jinchi, was made superintendent of Mengding Route and granted a tiger tally.

s0037.literal: That month Jimo County was struck by hail.
s0037.idiomatic: That month Jimo County was struck by hail.

s0038.literal: Fifth month, gengxu new moon: Venus transgressed Charriot Ghost.
s0038.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the gengxu new moon, Venus transgressed Charriot Ghost.

s0039.literal: On renzi day ritual offerings were first opened at Longevity and Tranquility Palace; the sun, Grand Year, fire, earth, and other stars were sacrificed to at the Bureau of Astronomy.
s0039.idiomatic: On renzi day ritual offerings were first opened at Longevity and Tranquility Palace; the sun, Grand Year, fire, earth, and other stars were sacrificed to at the Bureau of Astronomy.

s0040.literal: On wuwu day Acting Grand Preceptor Udutai was dispatched bearing jade tablets and a jade seal to confer on the late emperor the honorific title Emperor Sacred in Virtue, Divine in Achievement, Martial and Civil; the temple name was Shizu;
s0040.idiomatic: On wuwu day Acting Grand Preceptor Udutai was dispatched bearing jade tablets and a jade seal to confer on the late emperor the honorific title Emperor Sacred in Virtue, Divine in Achievement, Martial and Civil; the temple name was Shizu;

s0041.literal: the empress was granted the honorific title Empress Zhaorui Shunsheng;
s0041.idiomatic: the empress was granted the honorific title Empress Zhaorui Shunsheng;

s0042.literal: our late father was granted the honorific title Emperor Wenhui Mingxiao; the temple name was Yuzong.
s0042.idiomatic: our late father was granted the honorific title Emperor Wenhui Mingxiao; the temple name was Yuzong.

s0043.literal: King Hetong was granted two hundred fifty taels of gold, Oljei Temür one hundred fifty taels, and Bayan and Ochicharu fifty taels each; silver, notes, and brocade were granted in varying amounts.
s0043.idiomatic: King Hetong was granted 250 taels of gold, Oljei Temür 150 taels, and Bayan and Ochicharu 50 taels each; silver, notes, and brocade were granted in varying amounts.

s0044.literal: On gengshen day the Purple Forbidden star was sacrificed to at Cloud Immortal Terrace.
s0044.idiomatic: On gengshen day the Purple Forbidden star was sacrificed to at Cloud Immortal Terrace.

s0045.literal: Headmen Shixi of southern Yunnan, cave lord Tan Shun of Sichuan Sanmao, and others came bearing tribute goods; their cave was promoted to a prefecture.
s0045.idiomatic: Headmen Shixi of southern Yunnan, cave lord Tan Shun of Sichuan Sanmao, and others came bearing tribute goods; their cave was promoted to a prefecture.

s0046.literal: On dingmao day Woluosi, pacification commissioner of the Eight Banners, broke the law, was sued by others, and in fear of punishment fled back to the capital.
s0046.idiomatic: On dingmao day Woluosi, pacification commissioner of the Eight Banners, broke the law, was sued by others, and in fear of punishment fled back to the capital.

s0047.literal: Prince Anxi Ananda was granted ten thousand ingots of notes.
s0047.idiomatic: Prince Anxi Ananda was granted 10,000 ingots of notes.

s0048.literal: On jisi day the former heir apparent's residence where the empress dowager dwelled was changed to Longfu Palace; the Household Directorate was changed to the Empress's Administration Directorate; deliberators were styled middle deliberators, household administrators palace administrators, stewards inner stewards, medical officers palace physicians, treasurers palace attendants, equipment officers palace ritualists, and provision officers palace provisioners; controlled cranes were still increased to three hundred men.
s0048.idiomatic: On jisi day the former heir apparent's residence where the empress dowager dwelled was changed to Longfu Palace; the household directorate was changed to the empress's administration directorate; deliberators were styled middle deliberators, household administrators palace administrators, stewards inner stewards, medical officers palace physicians, treasurers palace attendants, equipment officers palace ritualists, and provision officers palace provisioners; controlled cranes were still increased to 300 men.

s0049.literal: An edict directed that transport commissioners in every place who concealed fraud and were sued by others should be immediately investigated by the surveillance commission; their case documents were still to be inspected at year's end according to the old rule.
s0049.idiomatic: An edict directed that transport commissioners in every place who concealed fraud and were sued by others should be immediately investigated by the surveillance commission; their case documents were still to be inspected at year's end according to the old rule.

s0050.literal: The Fujian Salt Intendant's Office was promoted to a Salt Transport Commission, and rewards for capturing illicit salt traffickers were increased.
s0050.idiomatic: The Fujian salt intendant's office was promoted to a salt transport commission, and rewards for capturing illicit salt traffickers were increased.

s0051.literal: On gengwu day Prince Yilibuhua came to court; emaciated horses were delivered to the government, and the government paid their value in ten thousand five hundred ingots of notes.
s0051.idiomatic: On gengwu day Prince Yilibuhua came to court; emaciated horses were delivered to the government, and the government paid their value in 10,500 ingots of notes.

s0052.literal: Fifty thousand shi of grain were granted to the officers and soldiers of the armies of Yesudai'er and Wang Weizheng to supply the northern campaign army.
s0052.idiomatic: 50,000 shi of grain were granted to the officers and soldiers of the armies of Yesudai'er and Wang Weizheng to supply the northern campaign army.

s0053.literal: On renshen day censorate officials said: "Government offices within and without are being added more and more; those receiving salaries in the capital number ten thousand men, and outside the capital they are especially numerous; it is fitting to reduce and consolidate them.
s0053.idiomatic: On renshen day censorate officials said, "Government offices within and without are being added more and more; those receiving salaries in the capital number 10,000 men, and outside the capital they are especially numerous; it is fitting to reduce and consolidate them.

s0054.literal: " An order directed deliberation with the central secretariat.
s0054.idiomatic: An order directed deliberation with the central secretariat.

s0055.literal: At Cui Yu's recommendation, surveillance commission case documents were not to be inspected and impeached by the chief prefecture.
s0055.idiomatic: At Cui Yu's recommendation, surveillance commission case documents were not to be inspected and impeached by the chief prefecture.

s0056.literal: An edict ordered deliberation on increasing officials' salaries.
s0056.idiomatic: An edict ordered deliberation on increasing officials' salaries.

s0057.literal: Because the officers and soldiers under Yesudai'er were impoverished, ten thousand ingots of notes were granted.
s0057.idiomatic: Because the officers and soldiers under Yesudai'er were impoverished, 10,000 ingots of notes were granted.

s0058.literal: On yihai day Zhasan was made vice director of the privy council.
s0058.idiomatic: On yihai day Zhasan was made vice director of the privy council.

s0059.literal: On wuyin day the imperial aunt, consort of King Wang Ju of Koryo Qutluq Jalaimishi, was enfeoffed as Princess of Anping.
s0059.idiomatic: On wuyin day the imperial aunt, consort of King Wang Ju of Koryo Qutluq Jalaimishi, was enfeoffed as Princess of Anping.

s0060.literal: Yidughu was granted five hundred fifty taels of gold and seven thousand five hundred taels of silver; Qaimiridjin Tälin was granted fifty taels of gold and four hundred fifty taels of silver.
s0060.idiomatic: Yidughu was granted 550 taels of gold and 7,500 taels of silver; Qaimiridjin Tälin was granted 50 taels of gold and 450 taels of silver.

s0061.literal: Prince Xiping Aoluchi said: "In Marshal Wang's army many rich and substantial men are shielded while the poor and weak are made to perform corvée.
s0061.idiomatic: Prince Xiping Aoluchi said, "In Marshal Wang's army many rich and substantial men are shielded while the poor and weak are made to perform corvée.

s0062.literal: " An order directed that this be changed.
s0062.idiomatic: An order directed that this be changed.

s0063.literal: Oljei Temür was made grand preceptor, Bayan grand tutor, and Ochicharu grand guardian.
s0063.idiomatic: Oljei Temür was made grand preceptor, Bayan grand tutor, and Ochicharu grand guardian.

s0064.literal: All offices were forbidden forcibly to seize salt boats and transport relay goods, and monks, Daoists, and powerful households were forbidden privately to conceal and illicitly sell salt.
s0064.idiomatic: All offices were forbidden forcibly to seize salt boats and transport relay goods, and monks, Daoists, and powerful households were forbidden privately to conceal and illicitly sell salt.

s0065.literal: That month Mizhou Route's various cities and counties, Dadu Route's Wuqing County, and Xizhou Route suffered hail; Xizhou Route suffered great flooding.
s0065.idiomatic: That month Mizhou Route's various cities and counties, Dadu Route's Wuqing County, and Xizhou Route suffered hail; Xizhou Route suffered great flooding.

s0066.literal: Sixth month, gengchen new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
s0066.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the gengchen new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

s0067.literal: On xinsi day censorate officials said: "In the weight of name and status nothing exceeds grand councillor; only those whose achievements are outstanding may hold it; it must not be lightly granted.
s0067.idiomatic: On xinsi day censorate officials said, "In the weight of name and status nothing exceeds grand councillor; only those whose achievements are outstanding may hold it; it must not be lightly granted.

s0068.literal: Surveillance commission officials each year in the fifth month divide and inspect their jurisdictions, returning to office in the first month of the following year.
s0068.idiomatic: Surveillance commission officials each year in the fifth month divide and inspect their jurisdictions, returning to office in the first month of the following year.

s0069.literal: When officeholders commit bribery, those appointed by edict are heard by the chief office for deliberation; those appointed by commission are reported upward.
s0069.idiomatic: When officeholders commit bribery, those appointed by edict are heard by the chief office for deliberation; those appointed by commission are reported upward.

s0070.literal: Those in their own office whose conduct and reputation are poor are replaced; those accepting bribes are punished more heavily than others according to the old rule.
s0070.idiomatic: Those in their own office whose conduct and reputation are poor are replaced; those accepting bribes are punished more heavily than others according to the old rule.

s0071.literal: " The Emperor said: "Let this be deliberated together with the central secretariat.
s0071.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Let this be deliberated together with the central secretariat.

s0072.literal: " On yiyou day three trained elephants were presented from Jinchi Route in Yunnan.
s0072.idiomatic: On yiyou day three trained elephants were presented from Jinchi Route in Yunnan.

s0073.literal: On bingxu day, because Yunnan's annual tribute of two thousand five hundred horses for the Prince of Liang was too many, an order directed that the number be reduced according to measure.
s0073.idiomatic: On bingxu day, because Yunnan's annual tribute of 2,500 horses for the Prince of Liang was too many, an order directed that the number be reduced according to measure.

s0074.literal: On gengyin day envoys were sent from Bichaburi city Ganmudin bearing tribute.
s0074.idiomatic: On gengyin day envoys were sent from Bichaburi city Ganmudin bearing tribute.

s0075.literal: An edict abolished redundant posts in the Merit Office and the Treasury Office.
s0075.idiomatic: An edict abolished redundant posts in the Merit Office and the Treasury Office.

s0076.literal: On renchen day the Prince of Jin's Secretariat Office was established, and the Court of Imperial Entertainments was again subordinated to the Imperial Household Directorate.
s0076.idiomatic: On renchen day the Prince of Jin's secretariat office was established, and the court of imperial entertainments was again subordinated to the imperial household directorate.

s0077.literal: Central Secretariat officials said: "Aside from gifts at court assemblies, remaining notes total only two hundred seventy thousand ingots.
s0077.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "Aside from gifts at court assemblies, remaining notes total only 270,000 ingots.

s0078.literal: For all who request money and grain, we beg they be granted according to measure.
s0078.idiomatic: For all who request money and grain, we beg they be granted according to measure.

s0079.literal: " Standards for great-assembly rewards were fixed for Prince Xiping Aoluchi, Prince Ningyuan Kököchü, Prince Zhennan Tuohuan, and Yesü Temür: gold five hundred taels each, silver five thousand taels each, two thousand ingots of notes each, and two hundred bolts of silk each;
s0079.idiomatic: Standards for great-assembly rewards were fixed for Prince Xiping Aoluchi, Prince Ningyuan Kököchü, Prince Zhennan Tuohuan, and Yesü Temür: 500 taels of gold each, 5,000 taels of silver each, 2,000 ingots of notes each, and 200 bolts of silk each;

s0080.literal: Princes Temür Budaq, Yezhilibuhua, and others: gold four hundred taels each, silver four thousand taels each, one thousand six hundred ingots of notes each, and one hundred sixty bolts of silk each.
s0080.idiomatic: Princes Temür Budaq, Yezhilibuhua, and others: 400 taels of gold each, 4,000 taels of silver each, 1,600 ingots of notes each, and 160 bolts of silk each.

s0081.literal: Temür was again made grand councillor.
s0081.idiomatic: Temür was again made grand councillor.

s0082.literal: Yusufu of Prince Ajiji's division rebelled repeatedly and was executed.
s0082.idiomatic: Yusufu of Prince Ajiji's division rebelled repeatedly and was executed.

s0083.literal: Because rice prices in Gansu and other places soared, an edict forbade brewing wine.
s0083.idiomatic: Because rice prices in Gansu and other places soared, an edict forbade brewing wine.

s0084.literal: Ochicharu was ordered to superintend herd-management affairs.
s0084.idiomatic: Ochicharu was ordered to superintend herd-management affairs.

s0085.literal: On yiwei day the posthumous titles of Shizu, the empress, and Yuzong were proclaimed throughout the realm.
s0085.idiomatic: On yiwei day the posthumous titles of Shizu, the empress, and Yuzong were proclaimed throughout the realm.

s0086.literal: Package silver and salary notes for the current year were remitted everywhere, and land tax in the interior circuits and half the summer tax south of the Yangtze were remitted.
s0086.idiomatic: Package silver and salary notes for the current year were remitted everywhere, and land tax in the interior circuits and half the summer tax south of the Yangtze were remitted.

s0087.literal: On yihai day, because of wet-nurse service, Wanyan Bayan was enfeoffed as Duke of Ji and his wife Lady He as Duchess of Ji.
s0087.idiomatic: On yihai day, because of wet-nurse service, Wanyan Bayan was enfeoffed as Duke of Ji and his wife Lady He as Duchess of Ji.

s0088.literal: Wanze lent money to the people and took excessive interest; an order directed that Shizu's fixed regulations be followed.
s0088.idiomatic: Wanze lent money to the people and took excessive interest; an order directed that Shizu's fixed regulations be followed.

s0089.literal: On xinchou day Hongjilie Dai Alughui, surveillance commissioner of the Zhexi Circuit, accepted bribes; though pardoned by amnesty, he was again made surveillance commissioner of the Hexi-Longbei Circuit.
s0089.idiomatic: On xinchou day Hongjilie Dai Alughui, surveillance commissioner of the Zhexi Circuit, accepted bribes; though pardoned by amnesty, he was again made surveillance commissioner of the Hexi-Longbei Circuit.

s0090.literal: Censorate officials said: "In the former court's adjudication of cases, according to the severity of the offense different beatings and cudgelings were applied; now only the cudgel is used; we request the old system be restored.
s0090.idiomatic: Censorate officials said, "In the former court's adjudication of cases, according to the severity of the offense different beatings and cudgelings were applied; now only the cudgel is used; we request the old system be restored.

s0092.literal: Song envoy Jia Xuanweng, settled at Hejian, was over eighty years old; clothing was granted and he was sent back to his home.
s0092.idiomatic: Song envoy Jia Xuanweng, settled at Hejian, was over 80 years old; clothing was granted and he was sent back to his home.

s0093.literal: On guimao day imperial son-in-law Kuolejisi was enfeoffed as Prince of Tang and granted a gold seal.
s0093.idiomatic: On guimao day imperial son-in-law Kuolejisi was enfeoffed as Prince of Tang and granted a gold seal.

s0094.literal: On jiachen day an edict ordered the Hanlin Academy and National History Office to compile the Veritable Records of Shizu, with Wanze supervising the national history.
s0094.idiomatic: On jiachen day an edict ordered the Hanlin Academy and National History Office to compile the 《Veritable Records of Shizu》, with Wanze supervising the national history.

s0095.literal: On yisi day each thousand-household unit of the campaigning army under Künchütu was granted one thousand ingots of notes.
s0095.idiomatic: On yisi day each thousand-household unit of the campaigning army under Künchütu was granted 1,000 ingots of notes.

s0096.literal: On bingwu day the moon transgressed Well.
s0096.idiomatic: On bingwu day the moon transgressed Well.

s0097.literal: Because the campaigning armies under Sibaqa had supplied one thousand one hundred ninety-odd horses of their own, an order directed that their value be repaid.
s0097.idiomatic: Because the campaigning armies under Sibaqa had supplied 1,190-odd horses of their own, an order directed that their value be repaid.

s0098.literal: On wushen day an edict directed that officials and others within and without the imperial domain all obey the restraint of Chancellor Wanze.
s0098.idiomatic: On wushen day an edict directed that officials and others within and without the imperial domain all obey the restraint of Chancellor Wanze.

s0099.literal: Khalaj Baghshi was made imperial preceptor and granted a jade seal.
s0099.idiomatic: Khalaj Baghshi was made imperial preceptor and granted a jade seal.

s0100.literal: Princess Xuexuexijin was granted one thousand ingots of notes; three thousand ingots were granted to impoverished members of the divisions of Princes Badakhan and Mojaghar; Boyaqan, Chiri, Yuruboyarabarma, Kokekölün, and Mangkejen were each granted fifty taels of gold; silver, notes, and silk were granted in varying amounts.
s0100.idiomatic: Princess Xuexuexijin was granted 1,000 ingots of notes; 3,000 ingots were granted to impoverished members of the divisions of Princes Badakhan and Mojaghar; Boyaqan, Chiri, Yuruboyarabarma, Kokekölün, and Mangkejen were each granted 50 taels of gold; silver, notes, and silk were granted in varying amounts.
